title: 第1392章 神秘老妪再现第1391章 黑魂锁神阵
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: “什么，他竟然一剑劈开了黑魂锁神阵，这怎么可能？”
“我操，齐邵四人竟然败了，联手都没有接住李轩一剑，他真的是至仙境吗？”
“这简直离大谱了啊，赶紧回去告诉那些妖孽，天仙境初中期就不要出来自取其辱了，免得遭罪。”
看到齐邵四人竟然被一剑重创，刹那间，暗中那些帝坟宗弟子纷纷震撼了起来。
他们瞠目结舌，倒吸冷气，简直惊骇到了无以复加。
齐邵四人倒在地上，则是都有些怀疑人生。
他们实在是想不通，自己怎么就败了呢？
他们联手施展而出的黑魂锁神阵，竟是没有对李轩造成半分威胁，这着实是太过离谱了一些。
要知道，他们的黑魂锁神阵，就算是一些天仙境七重，都未必能够攻破，李轩区区一个至仙，哪怕肉身再无敌，也不能强到如此地步吧？
“滚吧，再敢来骚扰我，斩爆你们的狗头！你们应当庆幸，若非看在那位前辈帮过我的份上，你们早已人头落地。”
李轩冷漠的看着齐邵四人，没有半点客气，直接甩手四个大逼兜，将四人全部都抽飞了出去。
下一刻，他就犹如是一只大鸟横空，直接冲向远处，霎时间，远处那些隐藏在暗中的帝坟宗弟子，全都麻了。
“我操，我们只是来看看，并无恶意。”
“李兄，别，别打脸——”
“哎哟，你大爷——”
在一阵惊呼声中，他们甚至还没来得及做出反应，一只只蒲扇般的大手就已经闪电般出现，狠狠扇在了他们脸上。
下一秒，在鬼哭狼嚎间，所有人都被抽飞了出去，满脸开花，遍地找牙。
帝坟宗。
“最新消息，李轩已横扫我帝宗无数弟子，杀到了百里之外。”
“我操，齐邵四人竟然也败了！他们联手布置出的黑魂锁神阵被强势攻破不说，还被一剑斩飞了出去，皆都遭受到了重创。”
“妈的，那李轩实在是太嚣张了，竟然不分青红皂白，抽飞了我帝宗数十名弟子，跪求各位师兄出山，镇压此獠！”
震动。
前所未有的震动。
这些消息一出，当真是轰动了整个帝坟宗。
要知道，那些可都是帝坟宗的妖孽啊，怎么能够败的如此凄惨呢？
最关键的是，帝坟山还是他们的地盘，在自己的地盘上，竟然被人如此打脸，这简直都不能忍。
“废物，真是成事不足败事有余，我这便出去看看，看那李轩究竟是否有着三头六臂。”
“哼，区区一个蝼蚁，竟然还妄想翻天？真是活的不耐烦了！我这便出去领教一下那位持令者的高招。”
“山中无老虎，猴子称代王，蚍蜉也敢撼树，萤火也敢与皓月争辉？区区蛮夷，竟也敢动我齐云裳的弟弟，真是找死！”
正所谓一石激起千层浪，伴随着这些消息的传出，原本一些还自持身份修为，没好意思亲自下场的妖孽，都有些憋不住了。
他们纷纷出关，向着李轩杀了过去。
这些人，修为最低的都达到了天仙境九重，甚至有些人还达到了天仙境巅峰。
其中，又以一名女子最为耀眼，她名为齐云裳，乃是齐邵的姐姐，其天赋实力都要比齐邵强的多。
此刻，她听闻齐邵竟然败北，且还遭受到了重创和羞辱，顿时大怒出关，疯狂杀向了帝坟山。
帝坟山。
李轩距离帝坟宗已经不足五十里了。
只不过，由于帝坟宗位于一片独特的空间，所以他根本就看不到帝坟宗，依旧不知道前路有多远。
李轩极速前行着，心里也是有些欣慰。
因为伴随着齐邵四人被击败，以及那些吃瓜看戏者被抽飞，他这里总算是清净了许多，再也没有人过来找麻烦了。
然而，这种清静却是并没有持续多久，他的脸色就再次阴沉了下来。
因为他竟然感受到了命仙境强者的气息。
content_en:
"What, he actually split open the Black Soul Locking Formation with one sword. How is this possible?"
"Holy shit, the four of Qi Shao were defeated. They couldn't even catch Li Xuan's sword even though they worked together. Is he really in the Immortal Realm?"
"This is simply outrageous. Go back and tell those evildoers not to come out and humiliate themselves in the early and middle stages of the Celestial Realm to avoid suffering."
Seeing that the four of Qi Shao were seriously injured by a sword, the disciples of the Imperial Tomb Sect were secretly shocked.
They were dumbfounded, gasped, and simply horrified beyond measure.
The four of Qi and Shao fell to the ground, all doubting their lives.
They really couldn't figure it out, why did they lose?
The Black Soul Locking Formation they jointly used did not pose any threat to Li Xuan. This was really outrageous.
You know, even those at the seventh level of the Heavenly Immortal Realm may not be able to break through their Black Soul Locking Formation. Li Xuan, a mere immortal, no matter how invincible his body is, cannot be so strong, right?
"Go away, if you dare to harass me again, I'll chop off your heads! You should be lucky. If it weren't for the senior who helped me, you would have been killed long ago."
Li Xuan looked at Qi Shao and the four of them indifferently, and without any politeness, he directly waved his four big buttocks and flew all four of them out.
The next moment, he was like a big bird flying across the sky, rushing directly into the distance. In an instant, the disciples of the Imperial Tomb Sect hidden in the distance were all numb.
"Fuck, we're just here to take a look, no harm done."
"Brother Li, don't, don't slap me in the face——"
"Oh, your uncle——"
Amid a burst of exclamations, before they even had time to react, big palm-like hands appeared like lightning and slapped them hard on the face.
The next second, amid the howls of ghosts and wolves, everyone was sent flying out, with faces covered with flowers and teeth everywhere.
···
Emperor's Tomb Sect.
"The latest news is that Li Xuan has swept away countless disciples of our Emperor Sect and killed them hundreds of miles away."
"Holy shit, the four of Qi Shao were defeated! The Black Soul Locking Formation they jointly set up was not only powerfully broken, but also sent flying with a sword. They all suffered heavy losses."
"Damn it, that Li Xuan is so arrogant. He actually whipped out dozens of disciples of our Emperor Sect indiscriminately. I beg you all brothers to come out and suppress this beast!"
Vibration.
Unprecedented shock.
As soon as these news came out, it really caused a sensation in the entire Imperial Tomb Sect.
You know, those are all monsters from the Emperor's Tomb Sect, how could they be defeated so miserably?
The most important thing is that Emperor Tomb Mountain is still their territory. It is simply intolerable to be slapped in the face like this on their own territory.
"Trash, you really succeed more than you can accomplish. I'm going to go out and have a look to see if Li Xuan has three heads and six arms."
"Hmph, a mere ant actually wants to change the world? I'm so impatient! I'm going to go out and learn the clever tricks of the command holder."
"There are no tigers in the mountains, monkeys are kings, earthworms dare to shake trees, and fireflies dare to compete with the bright moon? A mere barbarian dares to touch my brother Qi Yunshang, he is really looking for death!"
As the saying goes, one stone stirs up a thousand waves. With the spread of these news, some monsters who were still holding on to their identity and cultivation and were too embarrassed to end up in person became a little unable to hold back.
They came out one after another and attacked Li Xuan.
Among these people, those with the lowest cultivation level have reached the ninth level of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and some have even reached the peak of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Among them, one woman is the most dazzling. Her name is Qi Yunshang. She is Qi Shao's sister. Her talent and strength are much stronger than Qi Shao's.
At this moment, when she heard that Qi Shao had been defeated and suffered heavy losses and humiliation, she immediately left the seclusion in a rage and went crazy towards the Emperor's Tomb Mountain.
···
Emperor's Tomb Mountain.
Li Xuan is less than fifty miles away from the Emperor's Tomb Sect.
However, because the Emperor's Tomb Sect is located in a unique space, he cannot see the Emperor's Tomb Sect at all, and he still doesn't know how far the road ahead is.
Li Xuan moved forward very quickly, feeling a little relieved in his heart.
Because with the defeat of Qi Shao and the four people, and the expulsion of those who were watching the theater, his place was finally a lot cleaner, and no one came to cause trouble anymore.
However, this tranquility did not last long, and his face darkened again.
Because he actually felt the aura of the powerful man in the Immortal Realm.
